attempts.party: party_sidney96.json led by Tapu Lele + Flutter Mane
attempts.why: Turn 1 Psychic Terrain shut Incineroar's Fake Out off the table; two Moonblasts OHKO'd Yveltal before its Tailwind; Flare Blitz put Flutter Mane on its Sash (240). Turn 2 Grimmsnarl Light Screen; Moonblast 283 on Grimmsnarl; Flutter Mane pivoted out for Urshifu. Turn 3 Grimmsnarl Reflect; Close Combat OHKO'd Incineroar, a crit Moonblast KO'd Grimmsnarl through its own screen. Turn 4 Sharpedo Mega Evolved and Strong Jaw Psychic Fangs OHKO'd Urshifu-Rapid (253); Urshifu-Single-Strike outsped Tapu Lele by one point and Wicked Blow KO'd it (190). Turn 5 Flutter Mane Moonblast OHKO'd Mega Sharpedo through Light Screen, Wicked Blow KO'd the 2-HP Flutter Mane, Pixilate Hyper Voice 4x OHKO'd Urshifu. Turn 6 Absol Protected the Fake Out + Moonblast without Mega Evolving; turn 7 Close Combat 182 on Incineroar, then a crit Flare Blitz OHKO'd Absol (still un-Mega'd). Faints: Urshifu-Rapid, Tapu Lele, Flutter Mane.

ai_notes: Sharpedo Mega Evolving immediately is defensible (the dossier's 'earn a Speed Boost first' timing is optional). Urshifu targeting the 190-HP Tapu Lele for the KO over the fresh Urshifu-Rapid was right. The room is a clear step above Victory Road in play: three of the player's six fell and every opposing attack that landed was a one-hit KO.
level_change_rationale: Won first try 6-3 after a real fight against a hand-crafted room. Keep. The un-Mega'd Absol is an AI issue, not a level issue.
cooler: Dark Aura plus Fairy weakness across five members is the intended crack and it worked exactly as written: Fairy spread and Moonblast decided the fight. The room would be nastier if Yveltal's Tailwind went up (it never moved) - leading Grimmsnarl beside Yveltal (screens first) instead of Incineroar would give the Tailwind a turn. The Absol Mega timing is the only real gap. No set change.
